SOCIAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #9
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Vegetation in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Vegetation in Africa.
   B. Treat Vegetation in Africa as rumours only.
   C. Explain Vegetation in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Vegetation in Africa never happens in Kenya.

2. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Kisumu
   B. Mombasa
   C. Nakuru
   D. Nairobi

3. Which statement about Trans Saharan Slave Trade is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Trans Saharan Slave Trade.
   B. Explain Trans Saharan Slave Trade with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Trans Saharan Slave Trade as rumours only.
   D. Say Trans Saharan Slave Trade never happens in Kenya.

4. Which statement about Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain as rumours only.
   B. Explain Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain.

5. Which statement about Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration.

6. Which statement about Self- Esteem Assessment is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Self- Esteem Assessment.
   B. Explain Self- Esteem Assessment with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Self- Esteem Assessment as rumours only.
   D. Say Self- Esteem Assessment never happens in Kenya.

7. Which statement about Diversity and interpersonal skills is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Diversity and interpersonal skills.
   B. Say Diversity and interpersonal skills never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Diversity and interpersonal skills as rumours only.
   D. Explain Diversity and interpersonal skills with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

8. Which statement about Historical Sites and Monuments in Africa ● Fort Jesus ● Kilwa ● Great Zimbabwe ● is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Historical Sites and Monuments in Africa ● Fort Jesus ● Kilwa ● Great Zimbabwe ● with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Historical Sites and Monuments in Africa ● Fort Jesus ● Kilwa ● Great Zimbabwe ● as rumours only.
   C. Say Historical Sites and Monuments in Africa ● Fort Jesus ● Kilwa ● Great Zimbabwe ● never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Historical Sites and Monuments in Africa ● Fort Jesus ● Kilwa ● Great Zimbabwe ●.

9. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Avoiding all community work
   B. Littering in markets
   C. Destroying road signs
   D. Obeying laws and caring for public property

10. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Hide all money underground
   B. Avoid saving forever
   C. Ignore prices in shops
   D. Plan income and spending wisely

11. Which statement about Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe.
   B. Treat Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe as rumours only.
   C. Say Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. Which statement about Self- Improvement is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Self- Improvement as rumours only.
   B. Explain Self- Improvement with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Self- Improvement never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Self- Improvement.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Self- Improvement and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Self- Esteem Assessment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Scientific Theory about Human Origin and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
